passages.text: Chief complaint: headache for two weeks, present on waking most mornings.
History: new double vision when looking to the right, which began six days ago. No prior history of migraine.
Neurologic exam: alert and oriented. Cranial nerves II through XII assessed; limited right lateral gaze with horizontal diplopia. Strength 5/5 in all extremities. Sensation intact. Gait normal.
Assessment: headache with new diplopia (R51.9, H53.2). Neurologic red flag present.
Plan: order MRI brain (CPT 70553). Neurology referral placed.
